name: aquarium-game
description: MyAquarium11 — เกมเลี้ยงปลาในตู้ปลา (Three.js + WebGL + Vite)

scripts.emulators:blaze: npm run build:functions && npm run firebase -- emulators:start --project demo-aquarium --config firebase.blaze.json
scripts.test:rules: npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --project demo-aquarium --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --project demo-aquarium --only auth,firestore "node tests/e2e/run.mjs --mode rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build:functions && npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --project demo-aquarium --config firebase.blaze.json --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e:blaze: npm run build:functions && npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --project demo-aquarium --config firebase.blaze.json --only auth,firestore,functions "node tests/e2e/run.mjs --mode functions"
scripts.deploy:blaze: npm run firebase -- deploy --only firestore,functions --config firebase.blaze.json
